It reads DS Bot's own data and writes nothing of DS Bot's: no `state.j"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"son` edits, no `api/bot` calls that change state, not even a `locale` field that would flip your UI "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"language. The panel's own position, size and collapsed state live in your browser's localStorage."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Requirements: DSH (a Developer Preview build is fine), DS Bot `0.1.7` or `0.2.0` (the two this was b"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"uilt against), Node ≥ 20 to build from source."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The package is on npm. Add it to your profile's `package.json` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.jso"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"n`) and register the bundle:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then install in that directory with whatever the profile already uses — `pnpm install` if it has a `"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"pnpm-lock.yaml`, otherwise `npm install` — and restart DSH completely:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"To change the code instead of just using it, clone and link:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The panel appears bottom-right. The client half hot-reloads after `npm run build`; changes under `sr"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"c/host/` need a restart."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Windows: the npm install needs no symlink at all. Only the source path does, and `ln -sfn` is Unix-o"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"nly — use `mklink /D "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-bot-board" "C:\path\to\ds"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"h-bot-board"` from an elevated `cmd`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## What it shows"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Three bands, ordered by whether you have to do anything:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. Needs you — up to three rows of Bots waiting on an approval, a question, or a failed turn. Each r"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ow: the Bot's face, its name, the action in its own words, how long it has waited, and a lamp. When "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"more than three are waiting the third row grows a `+N` chip that expands the list in place.
2. Movin"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"g — the classroom floor: Bots that are running, waiting on another Bot, or just finished (7 seconds)"},{"id":"p17s5","text":". Hand-off edges sit above the grid.
3. Idle — one line of names. When nothing is running and nothin"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"g is owed, the line becomes a roster instead: one 44px row per resting Bot with its face, its name, "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"its role (or model) and 闲着 on the right. The roster reflows to two or three columns on a smaller pan"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"el, so no Bot is ever behind a scroll. A `!` badge sits on a Bot that failed and has since gone quie"},{"id":"p17s9","text":", so no Bot is ever behind a scroll. A `!` badge sits on a Bot that failed and has since gone quiet."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The three bands differ by image, row height, weight and surface, not by background colour. Status co"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lour appears only on the 3px bar and the lamps."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Six states"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| State | Lamp | Shape | Means |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Working | green | circle | running, thinking, searching, sending, handing over |
| Needs you | yel"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"low | **square** | an approval, a question, or a new Bot waiting for a model pick |
| Waiting on a B"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ot | blue | circle | it is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, not for you |
| Stuck | red | "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"**diamond** | failed, and not working now. After 3 quiet minutes it drops to idle with a red `!` |
|"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" Idle | grey | circle | nothing running |
| Just finished | teal | circle | a clean hand-off landed;"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" falls back after 7 seconds |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Colour alone does not carry the state: stuck is a diamond, needs-you is a square, the rest are circl"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"es, and each lamp has an outline. Green and red sit 13.6 ΔE apart for red-green colour blindness — c"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lose enough that shape has to do the work."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Where the faces come from"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A Bot's look is DS Bot's, not this board's. Two fields decide it:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Axis | Source | Values |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Character (body outline) | `bots[].avatar.shape` | `whale` `star` `moon` `wave` `squircle` `zed` `"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"hex` |
| Colour | `bots[].color` | 19 named inks or any `#rrggbb` |
| Desk prop | this board | 10 pr"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ops, hashed from the Bot id |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The seven outlines are redrawn from DS Bot's own shapes: the whale keeps its tail, the bull its horn"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s, the blossom its petals. Face disc and eyes shrink per outline, because a star's concave points ca"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"nnot hold an 18px disc; the two silhouettes without a round edge have no hands."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"DS Bot stores those two fields only when the user picked them, so a new Bot usually has neither. Wha"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"tever is missing is hashed from the Bot id: 12 colours × 7 outlines × 10 props = 840 combinations, s"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"table across refreshes, and a collision is re-rolled. Upstream always wins over the hash."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Names are not part of identity. A Bot called `Chief` gets nothing extra for the name — `avatar.shape"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"` is a closed set of seven, and names are free text in whatever language you type."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Where the data comes from"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| What | From |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Live status, current tool, elapsed time, approvals, questions, a new Bot waiting for a model | DS "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"Bot's `POST api/bot` (`endpoint: "state"`), 1.5s while anything runs, 6s after 90s of a fully idle t"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"eam |
| Hand-offs (`from`/`to`/`open`/`results`), room names | `~/.dsh/bot/state.json`, read by the "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"host half, cached on `mtime+size`, polled every 5s |
| Failures | DSH's `agent/error`, mapped back t"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"o a Bot by session, kept for 15 minutes |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Polling slows down when the panel is collapsed, the window is hidden, or requests keep failing (expo"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"nential backoff, 8× cap, 30s ceiling). This is not about battery: `api/bot` runs `refresh + bootstra"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"p + catalog + loadSecrets` on every call, and `unchanged` only saves response size. An idle board le"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ft open still costs the upstream 40 of those a minute, and that is what the slow-down reduces."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"If you moved DS Bot's data folder (`bot.home` in its config), point this plugin at the same folder:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`state.json` carries DS Bot's data format version. If it is not `1`, the panel says so — a moved fie"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ld fails by reading the wrong value, not by crashing, and silence would be worse."}],"truncated":true}
